<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/accounting/reports/years"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns every fiscal year with a computed report that still has at least one transaction, including years with no disposals (e.g. only incoming transfers, buys or income). Excludes years whose report row exists but whose transactions were all deleted (e.g. a year fully drained by an integration deletion).
